_comment: PRISM skill-domain map (v5.12.0) — rubric-ONLY registry consumed by the Agent Quality Gate (hooks/prism-agent-quality-gate.mjs) and prism-freshness-sweep capability-staleness. It holds ONLY the quality-bar data that does not already live in roster.json: per-domain recommended top-tier skills, external research sources, recommended tools/MCPs, cross-cutting depth references a best-in-class builder needs, and the minimum research tier for a role:builder agent (1 = external/NotebookLM-grounded best; 3 = codebase-only). The skill<->domain mapping itself is ALSO derivable from roster.skills[].domains + roster.domain_groups; this file is the authoritative source for the rubric bits. Maintained as part of /prism-update. Edit to add domains as the bench grows.

skills: recommended top-tier skill names (matched against the agent skills: frontmatter + body)
research_sources: external authorities a Tier-1 agent should be grounded in
tools: recommended installed Tier-1 tools / MCPs for the domain
depth_refs: cross-cutting reference topics a best-in-class builder must cover (grepped in the agent body)
